video.decoding_capability: AI on: 1-ch@12 MP (30 fps)/2-ch@8 MP (30 fps)/4-ch@4 MP (30 fps); AI off: 2-ch@12 MP (30 fps)/3-ch@8 MP (30 fps)/6-ch@4 MP (30 fps)

features: 8-ch line crossing, intrusion, region entrance and region exiting detection, facial recognition, ANPR, VCA (need IP camera support)
2-ch line crossing, intrusion, region entrance and region exiting detection by NVR (camera resolution up to 4 MP)
1-ch, 8 MP facial detection and analytics; 4-ch face picture comparison
Up to 16 face picture libraries with up to 20,000 face pictures in total
Facial recognition, Motion Detection 2.0 and perimeter protection cannot be enabled at the same time
notes: Datasheet (N98PBH) gives a DC 48 V 2.5 A supply; the product page gives 100 to 240 V AC. Supply left out.

The product page specification table gives up to 8 MP, 80 Mbps incoming bandwidth and 2-ch@8 MP (25 fps)/8-ch@1080p (30 fps) playback capacity; its title and the datasheet give 12 MP and 2-ch 12 MP decoding.
